forum.title: CE Certification STM32G071RB
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @yz\_89 and welcome to the ST community,

I don't think there is a CE conformity for the MCU itself but CE conformity is available for their ST boards.

Example: STM32 Nucleo-64 boards (NUCLEO-G070RB, NUCLEO-**G071RB**), the CE conformity is provided in the user manual of the board section ***11 CE conformity***:

![screenshot.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/22ba8151-60b0-ae6d-40cf-a147da1c33f3.png "screenshot.png")

It states that the complete declaration of conformity is available upon request from ST. The community channel is not intended to provide a such detail. So if this is not what you are looking for or you need more details, I suggest to contact your local sales or FAE or submit an online support ticket over this link: <https://ols.st.com/>

Thank you
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am currently preparing the documentation package for CE certification of a device that uses the **STM32G071RB** microcontroller.

Could you please clarify whether there is any official **CE compliance documentation** available for this MCU (or for the STM32G0 series), such as:

* CE declaration or compliance statement

* RoHS / REACH declaration

* environmental or material compliance documentation

* any other certificates typically provided for regulatory documentation

If a direct **CE certificate is not applicable to the microcontroller itself**, could you please advise which official documents from ST are recommended to include in the **technical file for CE marking** of the final product?

A link to the relevant documents or the ST compliance page would also be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Best regards
forum.author: yz_89
